{{Short description|Georgian mathematician who developed a kernel regression method}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2024}} 
'''Èlizbar Nadaraya''' is a Georgian mathematician who is currently a Full Professor and the Chair of the Theory of Probability and Mathematical Statistics at the [[Tbilisi State University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://science.org.ge/?team=nadaraya-elizbar&lang=en|title = Nadaraya Elizbar}}</ref> He developed the [[Nadaraya-Watson estimator]] along with [[Geoffrey Watson]], which proposes estimating the [[conditional expectation]] of a [[random variable]] as a locally weighted average using a [[Kernel (statistics)|kernel]] as a weighting function.<ref>{{cite journal
  | last = Nadaraya
  | first = E. A.
  | title = On Estimating Regression
  | journal = Theory of Probability and Its Applications
  | volume = 9
  | issue = 1
  | pages = 141–2
  | year = 1964
  | doi = 10.1137/1109020 
  }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |first=G. S. |last=Watson |title=Smooth regression analysis |journal=Sankhyā: The Indian Journal of Statistics, Series A |volume=26 |issue=4 |pages=359–372 |year=1964 |jstor=25049340 }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |first=Herman J. |last=Bierens |title=Topics in Advanced Econometrics |location=New York |publisher=Cambridge University Press |year=1994 |isbn=0-521-41900-X |chapter=The Nadaraya–Watson kernel regression function estimator |pages=212–247 |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=M5QBuJVtbWQC&pg=PA212 }}</ref>

Nadaraya was born in 1936 in [[Khobi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]. He received his doctoral degree from the V.I. Romanovski Institute of Mathematics, [[Tashkent]] in 1981. He has since co-authored over 120 publications including 5 textbooks in the area of probability and statistics.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://science.org.ge/wp-content/cv/Nadaraya%20Elizbar.pdf|title=Nadaraya CV}}</ref>
